rules: Existing V1 records are enriched instead of duplicated where a valid target exists.
MLG umbrella/layout/livery tokens are not promoted to standalone technical classes.
Parent/child and component relations are explicit where a new subtype/component is added.
Technical data remain source-scoped; subtype/example-specific values are not generalized.

pass10_full_coverage.meaning_of_100_percent: Every matchable MLG drawing has a catalogue ID. This is not a claim that every provisional identity or technical specification has been externally validated.

pass11_true100.scope: MLG matchable rolling-stock material; user-excluded loads, containers, track and scenery remain out of matching scope; non-autonomous animation assets remain out of scope.
pass11_true100.technical_rule: No new numeric technical values are inferred from identity sources. Existing sourced technical data are preserved; otherwise null.
pass11_true100.meaning_of_100_percent: 100% final disposition: every in-scope MLG drawing has a catalog ID and a final identity disposition. This is deliberately not a claim that every drawing has an externally validated canonical real-world series; unresolved identities are explicitly final-unresolved rather than hidden or pending.
